x: A couple of miles into the National Junior Cross Country Championships at Parliament Hill and Belgrave's Kaessa Tadesse leads Coventry Godiva's Stefan White (186), the eventual winner , Blackheath's Tim Dickinson (behind), who ended up 4th, and 'Southern' winner Spencer Barden (242) of GEC Avionics, 3rd.

This broke the field, apart from Spencer Barden who had won so convincingly in the South of Thames a month before, Tim Dickinson, running a 'blinder' for Blackheath, and Stefan White of Coventry Godiva, runner up at Luton in 1991, and running for the third time as a Junior.

This is a 'follow the leader' course and the leaders were already away, the Blackheath pair of Tim Dickinson and Liam Bulson ran neck and neck to the very end followed closely by Hyde of Windsor, Slough & Eton.
